title: Graph Hierarchical Recurrence for Long-Range Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2605.18387v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks and Graph Transformers have become central to graph learning, combining expressive representation learning with sample-efficient inductive biases. Yet they remain fundamentally limited when predictions depend on correlations between distant graph regions. We address this limitation with Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR), a novel framework that jointly operates on the input graph and a pooled hierarchical abstraction. We also show that existing models degrade more sharply under out-of-range generalization, where test instances require interactions across distances exceeding those observed during training. Despite its minimal design, GHR consistently strengthens every tested message-passing backbone, yielding robust performance on long-range dependencies and particularly pronounced gains in out-of-range regimes. translated_title: 面向长程泛化的图层次递归
translated_abstract: 图神经网络和图Transformer已成为图学习的核心方法，将富有表现力的表示学习与样本高效的归纳偏置相结合。然而，当预测依赖于图上相距遥远区域之间的相关性时，它们仍然存在根本性的局限。我们提出了图层次递归（GHR），这是一个新颖的框架，它同时在输入图和池化后的层次抽象上进行操作。我们还表明，现有模型在超范围泛化场景下性能下降更为剧烈，即测试实例需要跨越超过训练时观测距离的远程交互。尽管设计简洁，GHR持续增强了所有测试过的消息传递骨干网络，在长程依赖上表现出稳健的性能，并在超范围场景下取得了尤为显著的提升。在广泛的长程基准测试套件中，GHR实现了最先进或具有竞争力的结果。
tldr: 提出图层次递归（GHR）框架，通过同时在输入图和池化的层次抽象上操作，持续增强各类消息传递骨干网络处理长程依赖的能力，并在超范围泛化场景下取得显著提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes Graph Hierarchical Recurrence (GHR), a minimal framework that jointly operates on the input graph and a pooled hierarchical abstraction, consistently strengthening message-passing backbones on long-range dependencies with particularly pronounced gains in out-of-range generalization.
